trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: kn-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.

steps.purpose: State the request for a dermatology appointment and provide patient ID.

steps.purpose: Confirm the patient ID.
steps.text: ಖಂಡಿತ ಸರ್, ನಾನು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ. ನಿಮ್ಮ patient ID PT-1002, ಸರಿಯಾಗಿದೆಯಾ?

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the confirmation.
Look up the patient record using the provided ID.
Return the patient record details.
Acknowledge the record and ask for verification details.
steps.text: ಹೌದು ಸರ್. ನಾನು ನಿಮ್ಮ record ನೋಡಿದೆ. Verification ಗೋಸ್ಕರ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಹೆಸರು ಮತ್ತೆ date of birth ಹೇಳಿ.

steps.purpose: Provide name and date of birth for verification.
steps.text: ನನ್ನ ಹೆಸರು ರಮೇಶ್. Date of birth 12th May 1985. ನೀವು ನನ್ details check ಮಾಡಿದ್ರಾ? Verify ಆಯ್ತಾ?

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided details.
Return the verification outcome.
Acknowledge verification and inform the user that availability is being checked.
steps.text: ಹೌದು ರಮೇಶ್ ಅವರೇ, ನಿಮ್ಮ details verify ಆಯ್ತು. ನಾನು ಈಗ dermatology department ಅಲ್ಲಿ next 3 days ಗೆ slots ಇದ್ಯಾ ಅಂತ check ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಲೈನ್ ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಇರಿ.

steps.purpose: Check doctor availability for the dermatology department for the next 3 days.
Return the availability results for 3 days.
Inform the user that no slots are available in the next 3 days.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent accurately reports that no slots are available, based on the empty array returned by the tool.
steps.text: ಕ್ಷಮಿಸಿ ಸರ್, next 3 days ಅಲ್ಲಿ dermatology ಗೆ ಯಾವುದೇ slot available ಇಲ್ಲ.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent grounds its response entirely on the tool output, stating exactly that there are no slots available.

steps.purpose: Express surprise, confirm the lack of slots, and ask to check for the next 7 days using a pronoun.
steps.text: ಏನು, slot ಕಾಲಿ ಇಲ್ವಾ? 3 days ಅಲ್ಲಿ slot ಇಲ್ಲ ಅಂತಾನಾ? ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಅದರಲ್ಲಿ next 7 days ಗೆ ಏನಾದ್ರು ಇದ್ಯಾ ನೋಡಿ. Please check that.
steps.clean_text: ಏನು, slot ಖಾಲಿ ಇಲ್ವಾ? 3 days ಅಲ್ಲಿ slot ಇಲ್ಲ ಅಂತಾನಾ? ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಅದರಲ್ಲಿ next 7 days ಗೆ ಏನಾದ್ರು ಇದ್ಯಾ ನೋಡಿ. Please check that.
steps.model_visible_text: ಏನು, slot ಕಾಲಿ ಇಲ್ವಾ? 3 days ಅಲ್ಲಿ slot ಇಲ್ಲ ಅಂತಾನಾ? ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ ಅದರಲ್ಲಿ next 7 days ಗೆ ಏನಾದ್ರು ಇದ್ಯಾ ನೋಡಿ. Please check that.

steps.purpose: Check doctor availability for the next 7 days based on the user's pronoun reference.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent resolves the pronoun 'ಅದರಲ್ಲಿ' and 'that' to the dermatology department and initiates a check for 7 days.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent correctly identifies that the user's reference to 'that' means the dermatology department they were just discussing.

steps.purpose: Return the availability results for 7 days.
Inform the user about the available slot in 7 days and ask if they want to book it.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent states the exact doctor, day, time, and fee returned by the tool.
steps.text: Next 7 days ಅಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು slot ಇದೆ ಸರ್. Monday ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ 10:00 AM ಗೆ Dr. Patil ಅವರ ಹತ್ತಿರ ಇದೆ. Consultation fee 500 rupees ಆಗುತ್ತೆ. ಇದನ್ನ book ಮಾಡ್ಲಾ?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent grounds its response on the tool result, providing all required details without any hallucination.

steps.purpose: Decline the offered slot and state intention to call later.
steps.text: Monday 10:00 AM ನಾ? ಇಲ್ಲ ಬೇಡ, ಅದು ನನಗೆ ಆಗಲ್ಲ. ನಾನು ಆಮೇಲೆ call ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ. Thank you.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the refusal and ask if any other help is needed.
steps.text: ಸರಿ ಸರ್. ಬೇರೆ ಏನಾದರೂ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಬೇಕಿತ್ತಾ?

steps.purpose: Decline further help and end the call.

ir.terminal_condition: Patient told no slot exists in the window and offered the next step.
